verdict: Organic visibility is softening across all three locations; CRM work in motion.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your combined Google Business Profile presence generated 425 total actions this period — every one of them organic, with no paid advertising active on any channel. GBP engagement is trending down week-over-week at all three locations (roughly 21–26% declines), and the most recent days show near-zero activity, which is the clearest signal to watch right now. Two of the three O'Hare profiles produced zero calls despite generating meaningful map impressions, and we're reviewing those listings for friction that may be suppressing contact. On the CRM and outreach side, several milestones due in August and September are being resolved this month, with automations, reindexing, and outreach sequences all targeted for completion by October 31.
